## Natera and KSQ Therapeutics Collaborate on Phase I/II KSQ-004EX Study, Leveraging Natera’s Signatera™ Test for Treatment Response Monitoring


11/23/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 113 KB](https://s201.q4cdn.com/354493536/files/doc_news/Natera-and-KSQ-Therapeutics-Collaborate-on-Phase-III-KSQ-004EX-Study-Leveraging-Nateras-Signatera-Test-for-Treatment-Response-Monitor-ZD7YR.pdf)


AUSTIN, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Natera, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.natera.com&esheet=54644830&newsitemid=20261123985665&lan=en-US&anchor=Natera%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=937087749abf61c289a7685af67819d4) (NASDAQ: NTRA), a global leader in cell-free DNA and precision medicine, today announced a new collaboration with KSQ Therapeutics, Inc. (KSQ), a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing cancer and autoimmune therapies based on precision functional genomics. The collaboration will incorporate Signatera™ Genome with Phased and Structural variants into an ongoing phase I/II clinical study of KSQ-004EX, an investigational engineered autologous tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (eTIL) therapy in which the genes encoding SOCS1 and Regnase-1 are inactivated using CRISPR/Cas9.


In KSQ-004EX, a patient’s own tumor-fighting immune cells are genetically modified with the goal of enhancing their potency and durability against cancer. The phase I/II study (NCT06598371) is designed to evaluate patients with late-stage metastatic melanoma, non-small cell lung cancer, head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, colorectal cancer, pancreatic cancer, and cervical cancer.


Using its Signatera Genome test, Natera will conduct retrospective analyses of patient samples collected from the clinical trial at multiple timepoints, including at baseline, to understand how treatment with KSQ-004EX impacts circulating tumor DNA levels and to identify potential correlates with clinical responses.


“Understanding tumor response kinetics at a molecular level is becoming essential to early-phase oncology development, and Signatera Genome with Phased and Structural variants provides unparalleled sensitivity,” said Eric Matthews, General Manager of Biopharma at Natera. “We are excited to partner with KSQ to help advance KSQ-004EX.”


**About Natera**


Natera is a global leader in cell-free DNA and precision medicine, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. We aim to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard-of-care to protect health and inform earlier, more targeted interventions that help lead to longer, healthier lives. Natera’s tests are supported by more than 475 peer-reviewed publications that demonstrate excellent performance. Natera operates ISO 13485-certified and CAP-accredited laboratories certified under the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) in Austin, Texas, San Carlos, California, and Boulder, Colorado. For more information, visit[www.natera.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.natera.com%2F&esheet=54644830&newsitemid=20261123985665&lan=en-US&anchor=www.natera.com&index=2&md5=23333ba0322b6805ab8cbbc454f8d19f) .
